method: Codex in-app browser, local HTTP preview; final HTML and extracted EPUB content with .html preview extensions

checks.observation: Target/comparisons and caption inspected at desktop size. At 390px the existing 900px horizontal pane exposes every comparison by scrolling; caption stays in column.
Bar labels and values visible at desktop and narrow widths; caption preserves design and sample limits.
Simplified figure and updated caption render; narrow view retains horizontal-pane behavior.
Branching diagnostic renders without its former general advice footer.
Three compact mechanisms render at desktop and 390px. Caption/prose retain ITT, missingness and interference boundaries.

limitations: Browser preview of extracted EPUB content is not a test in every native e-reader.
Wide figures retain the existing horizontal reading pane on small screens; they are not all designed to fit in one phone viewport.
Standalone/contact-sheet review covers all 108 numbered figures; final destination visual sampling covers representative revised figures.
